They are open until 11:00 PM tonight with a price range of around $$$, and while they recommend smart casual attire, the atmosphere is sophisticated yet welcoming. Fun fact—the menu is actually inspired by regional American brasseries, so you get these elevated takes on classic dishes like their signature shellfish platters. I can help you get in touch with the host team if you'd like to coordinate a reservation. 

After dinner, the Wolf Den usually has great live music just a short walk away. Are you looking for a full sit-down experience or something a bit faster?
